propositions: A centralized metric registry must map each metric id to its lens, data source, compute function, and confidence level so the command is written once.
Metrics with no available data must return an Unavailable state carrying both a reason and an ISO-formatted accruing_since timestamp.

The is_authoritative helper must segregate non-authoritative sources (backfill_classified, classified confidence) from authoritative ones (structural, git, sidecar, snapshot) to prevent fuzzy backfills from corrupting structural series.
Every REGISTRY entry must have a unique id, lens, source, and confidence field; duplicate ids must be detected and rejected.
The source and confidence labels must ride on every metric value to enable downstream aggregation to distinguish high-confidence structural data from classified backfills.
